name: Revenue Signal Radar
tagline: Finds the revenue already sitting in your HubSpot pipeline
description: Each weekday this bot combs a HubSpot instance for accounts worth a call: customers ripe for an upsell, deals that have gone quiet, and old losses worth reopening. It puts them in order, cites the records behind every pick, and drafts an opening message. Nothing in the CRM is ever changed.
author: ericosiu
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
